The Reddi Kingdom was founded by Prolaya Vema Reddi after the decline of the Kakatiyas. The rulers mentioned in this question succeeded one another in the following order: Anavota Reddi succeeded Prolaya Vema Reddi and consolidated the newly established kingdom. He was followed by Anavema Reddi, who further strengthened the administration and expanded the kingdom. After him came Kumaragiri Reddi, who was an able administrator and a great patron of literature, music and dance. His court became an important centre of Telugu culture. Finally, Pedakomati Vema Reddi ascended the throne. He was both a scholar and a capable ruler and continued the literary traditions established by his predecessors. s: In which war did the dominant Reddys defeat and expel the Velamas who penetrated into the economic life of Palnadu?
x:
After the decline of the Kakatiya Empire, several regional kingdoms emerged in Andhra Pradesh, among which the Reddi Kingdom and the Recherla Velama Kingdom became two powerful political forces. Both dynasties frequently competed for control over fertile territories and strategic trade routes. The Battle of Bhimavaram was fought between the Reddi rulers and the Velamas. In this battle, the Reddis achieved a decisive victory and successfully drove the Velamas out of the Palnadu region, thereby restoring their authority over the area. The victory greatly strengthened the Reddi Kingdom and enabled it to consolidate its political influence in Coastal Andhra. It also checked the expansionist ambitions of the Recherla Velamas for some time. Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).
Exam Note:
• Battle – Bhimavaram
• Result – Victory of Reddi rulers over the Velamas
• Importance – Strengthened Reddi control over Palnadu

s: "Sangeetha Sudhakaram" is a famous text on musicology authored by?
x:
Second Singabhupala authored the famous treatise Sangeetha Sudhakaram, an important work on Indian musicology. The text discusses various aspects of music, including ragas, talas, musical instruments and performance techniques, and is regarded as a valuable contribution to medieval South Indian music. Hence, the correct answer is Option (3).
Exam Note:
• Work – Sangeetha Sudhakaram
• Author – Second Singabhupala

s: Who wrote the commentary titled Sangeeta Sudhakaram on Sarngadeva's Sangeeta Ratnakara?
x:
Second Singabhupala authored Sangeeta Sudhakaram, a celebrated commentary on Sarngadeva's Sangeeta Ratnakara. The work explains important concepts relating to ragas, talas, vocal music and musical instruments, making it an important contribution to medieval Indian musicology. Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).
Exam Note:
• Commentary – Sangeeta Sudhakaram
• Author – Singabhupala II
